p: School Road is Sale's main shopping street, pedestrian-friendly and handy for everything in the town centre. This Admiral is an 18+ adult gaming centre, so it's for grown-ups only.

The Bridgewater Canal runs right through Sale, just a few minutes from School Road, with a towpath that's great for a walk or a bike ride. Waterside Arts sits alongside the canal and puts on theatre, music, comedy and exhibitions. Sale Water Park, out by the M60, has a big lake, woodland walks and plenty of space for the dog. And with the Metrolink running straight through town, Manchester city centre is only a short tram ride away if you want to carry on into the evening.
